commits.message:
refactor(examples): rich-dash and claude-sessions run on App; the dashboard runtime is gone (rich-runtime-fna.5)

Every full-screen demo now takes the terminal through App: none of them
enters the alternate screen, sets raw mode or tears either down itself.

- rich-dash: DashboardRuntime (Live + setInterval + stop) is deleted. The
  demo body owns only its clock; App owns the terminal. A widget with no
  layout cell now fails at startup instead of silently never drawing, and
  q / Esc / Ctrl+C quit and Ctrl+Z suspends — raw mode made Ctrl+C a key,
  so the entry's SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers go too.
- claude-sessions: Live + setRawMode + cleanup replaced by App; Ctrl+Z
  suspends. The status bar escapes its hint keys, so the `\` hint no
  longer swallows its closing tag.
- The browser wires stop calling host.start(): App starts the host.

feat(widgets): the wheel scrolls the innermost Viewport under the pointer (rich-viewport-owi.5) (#207)

* feat(widgets): the wheel scrolls the innermost Viewport under the pointer (rich-viewport-owi.5)

Viewport stamps every cell of its rows, gutter included, with
Segment.anchorLines, so the composed frame names it under any cell at any
depth, around its content's anchors. EventRouter sends a wheel notch to the
innermost Viewport on that chain (viewportAt), one line, and asks the source
for a frame through the new FrameSource.refresh; WidgetApp.refresh is
App.refresh.

The wheel no longer reaches widgets: WidgetMouseEvent's type is narrowed to
press, release and motion, so a widget under the pointer cannot hide the
viewport around it and no widget can handle a wheel twice.

* fix(widgets): the wheel passes over a viewport that cannot move to the one around it (rich-viewport-owi.5)

Review (high) found the innermost viewport kept every notch even when its
content fit or it sat at that end, so an outer viewport was dead under it
and each notch repainted for nothing. Viewport.canScrollBy answers against
the last render's extent; scrollTargetAt takes the innermost that can move.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(viewport): canScrollBy counts the moves queued since the last render (rich-viewport-owi.5)

Review (medium): a burst of notches in one input chunk was judged against
the last render's offset, so notches past the inner viewport's end died in
it instead of passing out. render and canScrollBy now share one resolve().

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(widgets): the wheel scrolls a Scrollable, and a mouse event narrows on its type (rich-viewport-owi.5)

Review (escalation high): hit.ts picked wheel targets with instanceof Viewport,
the first import from src/widgets into src/renderables. The wheel now asks
the Scrollable capability in core/protocol, beside Measurable.
ScreenMouseEvent is one member per type, so the router's wheel branch
narrows the event and the spread into WidgetMouseEvent needs no restated type.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(table): draw with Table.style and Column's three styles, as the reference does (rich-table-jph)

Table.style is the base the border style layers over; a column's headerStyle and
footerStyle layer over the table's, and its style sits under the row's rowStyles
entry. The cell's style now covers its padding and the blank lines a short cell
runs out of, which is where the reference puts it. Each case is pinned against
Python Rich 9d8f9a3's bytes.
